# PRODUCT.md — Acme Reports

**Stage:** emerging-PMF
**Last amended:** 2026-09-01
**Amendment count:** 2

## Purpose

Acme Reports turns a sales team's CRM activity into the weekly report their manager reads.

## The Problem

Sales managers at 20-to-200-seat teams spend part of every Monday rebuilding the same pipeline view by hand from CRM exports `[interview:P1,P4]`.

**Who has it:** sales managers at B2B companies with 20 to 200 reps `[interview:P1,P4,P6]`
**How they solve it today:** a spreadsheet refreshed by hand `[interview:P1]`
**What that costs them:** two to three hours per manager per week `[interview:P4,P6]`
